================================================================================
Member macro generator inside @interface
================================================================================

@interface AAOptions : NSObject
AAPropSetFuncDeclare(NSString *, name)
@property (nonatomic, copy) NSString *name;
@end

---

(translation_unit
  (class_interface
    (identifier)
    (identifier)
    (macro_declaration
      (identifier)
      (macro_argument_list
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))
    (property_declaration
      (property_attributes_declaration
        (property_attribute
          (identifier))
        (property_attribute
          (identifier)))
      (struct_declaration
        (type_identifier)
        (struct_declarator
          (pointer_declarator
            (identifier)))))))

      (method_definition
        (method_type
          (type_name
            (primitive_type)))
        (identifier)
        (compound_statement)))))

}

          (platform)
